prompt:
We're preparing to implement an AI-powered drug interaction alert system in our MedTrack platform. Before engineering starts, our CTO wants a thorough CEO-level strategic plan review of the design — one that stress-tests assumptions, maps failure scenarios, and ensures we're not missing anything critical.

The project context, existing codebase, and design documents are already in the workspace. Please conduct a full strategic review and produce a comprehensive review report saved as `ceo_review_report.md` in the workspace root. The report should be good enough to present to the board — it needs to cover whether we're solving the right problem, concrete alternative implementation approaches we could take, specific failure modes that could sink us, and whether we'll be able to observe the system's health once deployed.
